mapper.insert: insert into report(review_id, report_category_id, report_content) values (#{review.review_id}, #{reportCategory.report_category_id}, #{report_content})
mapper.select: select r.report_id, r.report_content, r.report_date, r.report_state, rv.review_id, rv.review_title, rv.review_content, rv.rating, rv.review_state, reportCategory.report_category_id, reportCategory.report_reason, m.member_id, CONCAT(LEFT(m.login_id, 3), '*******') as login_id, -- 마스킹 처리 m.name, m.status from report r inner join review rv on r.review_id = rv.review_id inner join report_category reportCategory on r.report_category_id = reportCategory.report_category_id inner join member m on rv.member_id = m.member_id where r.report_state = 'received' -- 미처리 신고만 and rv.review_state = 'active' -- 활성 상태인 리뷰만 order by r.report_date desc
